texts.zh:
我们收到报告，在[From.GetName]上出现了一种新兴的天气现象。

在星球的环境改造过程中，地壳中的水晶矿床暴露出来，并与改造过程中使用的化学物质发生反应，进而受到辐射。由此引发的空气温度波动导致了一场覆盖整个星球的持续雷暴。

这种独特的天气条件将不可避免地影响基础设施的建设，而受到辐射的水晶矿床也必然会对长期宜居性产生影响。然而，我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]相信，一旦环境改造完成，他们就能够利用这些风暴的能量。

此外，我们的[Owner.GetEngineerPlural]也制定了安全中和水晶矿床电荷的计划。这将消散风暴，并使我们能够安全地开采这些水晶用于其他用途。
texts.en:
We have received reports of an emerging weather phenomenon on [From.GetName].

Crystal deposits within the bedrock of the planet have become exposed during terraforming, reacting to the chemicals used in the process and becoming irradiated. The resulting fluctuations in air temperature have created a perpetual planet-wide lightning storm.

These unique weather conditions will inevitably impact infrastructure development, and the irradiated crystals are sure to have consequences for long-term habitability. However, our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] are confident they can harness the energy of the storms once terraforming is complete.

Alternatively, our [Owner.GetEngineerPlural] have also drawn up plans to safely neutralize the charge in the crystal deposits. This should dissipate the storms and allow us to safely harvest them for other uses.
